test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 21 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: The flagship programme of the Government of India, 'Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan' fulfills which of the following provisions of the Directive Principles of State Policy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 45**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 45** of the Directive Principles of State Policy in the Indian Constitution mandates the state to provide free and compulsory education for all children until they complete the age of fourteen years.
 
• **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)** was launched in 2001 to fulfil this mandate by ensuring universal access to education.
 
• The SSA aims to improve human capabilities through provision of community-owned quality education in a mission mode.
 
• The programme also seeks to bridge social, regional, and gender gaps, with the active participation of the community in the management of schools.
 
• The Right to Education Act (RTE) 2009 further strengthens Article 45 by making education a fundamental right for children aged 6 to 14 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**

 
 
• DPSPs are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government, which are non-justiciable in nature.
 
• These principles aim to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can lead a good life.
 
• They are enumerated in Part IV of the Indian Constitution, from Articles 36 to 51.
 
 
 
• **Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009**
 
 
• It provides for free and compulsory education to all children aged 6 to 14 years in India.
 
• It mandates that no child shall be held back, expelled, or required to pass a board examination until the completion of elementary education.
 
• The act also stipulates that the child or his/her parents shall not be subject to any screening procedure for admission to a school.
 
 
 
• **Universalization of Elementary Education**
 
 
• It refers to making education accessible to all children of elementary school age.
 
• SSA and RTE are significant steps towards achieving this goal in India.
 
 
 
• **Community Participation in Education**
 
 
• Involvement of local communities in the management and administration of schools.
 
• Encourages accountability and ensures that the educational needs of the community are met.
